events.verdict: Holmes (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball during Harris' (LAC) upward shooting motion.
[Observable in enhanced video] Daniels lifts his pivot foot prior to starting his dribble.
Holmes (PHX) establishes himself in a wide screening position in Bradley's (LAC) defensive path and contact occurs to his leg.
Melton (PHX) jumps alongside Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) and maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made after the gather.
LHH shows Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) is in a normal shooting motion and protects his shot attempt without extending his off-arm to affect Melton's (PHX) ability to defend.
Harris (LAC) briefly places his hand to Holmes' (PHX) opposite side hip as he rolls toward the lane but then slides it off.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) briefly engages with Melton (PHX) near the elbow before correcting.
Holmes (PHX) places his right hand to Gallinari's (LAC) front and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Gallinari (LAC) maintains his pivot foot after his gather.
Holmes (PHX) makes contact to Gallinari's (LAC) arm during his upward shooting motion that affects his shot attempt near the rim.

The crew communicated with the Replay Center to review the player altercation between the Clippers' Danilo Gallinari and the Suns' Troy Daniels. After review, it was determined that Gallinari would be assessed a technical foul. Replay Center official Curtis Blair assisted on the call.
Ariza (PHX) sets the pick on Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Harris (LAC) engages and disengages with Ariza (PHX) in the lane without affecting his FOM.
Gallinari (LAC) makes incidental foot-to-foot contact with Melton (PHX) as he rolls out of his screening position.
Ariza (PHX) makes incidental contact with Harris' (LAC) right arm as they each attempt to gain control of the rebound.
Harris (LAC) makes contact with Melton's (PHX) arm while it is wrapped around the ball.
Ariza (PHX) sets the pick on Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Holmes (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in Harris' (LAC) defensive path and absorbs the contact as it is made during the pick.
LLB/LAR show Melton (PHX) makes "high-five" contact with Gallinari (LAC) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Harris (LAC) draws Ayton (PHX) into the air towards him, which results in a foul on Ayton even if the contact is initiated by Harris.
Bridges (PHX) establishes himself in a screening position in Harris' (LAC) defensive path and absorbs contact as it is made during the screen.
Harris (LAC) makes marginal body contact with Ayton (PHX) during his upward shooting motion.
Ariza (PHX) engages and disengages with Gallinari (LAC) along the perimeter without affecting his FOM.
Melton (PHX) makes marginal contact with Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) at the end of his drive and does not affect his ability to gather and shoot.
As the hand-off takes place, Harris (LAC) makes marginal contact with Ariza (PHX) that does not affect his ability to control the pass.
Harris (LAC) makes marginal contact with Daniels' (PHX) backside after his gather.
Beverley (LAC) sets the screen on Bridges (PHX), who is stationary, and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Ariza (PHX) makes hand on ball contact with Harris (LAC) and dislodges the ball.
Beverley (LAC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Ariza (PHX).
Ariza (PHX) makes marginal contact with Harris' (LAC) arm during the dribble that does not affect his SQBR.

Daniels (PHX) is the secondary defender on the play, which originates outside the LDB. Daniels' right foot does not clear the RA as contact is made with Beverley (LAC) after his gather. He therefore does not maintain legal guarding position.
Gilgeous-Alexander (LAC) makes marginal contact with Melton's (PHX) arm after his gather.
Ayton (PHX) briefly holds Gallinari's (LAC) arm as the shot is released, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Daniels (PHX) and Harris (LAC) tie each other up as they attempt to retrieve the loose ball. A jump ball is correctly assessed.
Ayton (PHX) commits the take foul on Bradley (LAC).
